simple.summary: חַבָּר (chabbâr) means a partner First listed occurrence: Job 40 30.

definitions.full: H2271. chabbar [ חַבָּר ] noun masculine associate, partner in a trade or calling , only חַבָּרִים עָלָיו יִכְרוּ Job 40:30 will partners (i.e. those engaged in the catch) make traffic upon it (the crocodile)?
